object.name: evi_damp_coeffs
object.digest: Coefficients calculator for onepole damping filters
object.description: Coefficients calculator intended for Max schedular rate (in <o>gen</o> no tilde) for two evieve onepole damping/shelving filters. Used in many of the evieve reverb abstractions.

inlets.digest: Dummy inlet to feed @param values in. Does nothing else.

outlets.name: low
outlets.digest: Normalised frequency coefficient for Low filter.

outlets.name: high
outlets.digest: Normalised frequency coefficient for High filter.

attributes.name: HOST_SR
attributes.description: The real audio samplerate (not the samplerate of a gen no tilde object) must be passed in here for the coefficients calculations to work correctly.

attributes.name: cutoffhigh
attributes.description: High filter cutoff frequency in Hz.

attributes.name: cutofflow
attributes.description: Low filter cutoff frequency in Hz.

attributes.name: damphigh
attributes.description: High filter damping/shelving amount -1..1. Operation depends on @mode attribute.

attributes.name: damplow
attributes.description: Low filter damping/shelving amount -1..1. Operation depends on @mode attribute.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Mode of the coefficients calculations, affects damping/shelving and behaviour of @damplow and @damphigh attributes. If mode == 0: @damp attributes operate 0..1 only, with 0.==bypass, 1.==low or high passes (maximum damping), 0..1==shelving. If mode == 1: @damp attributes operate full range -1..1, with negative values shelf attenuate, positive values shelf boost, 0.==bypass. If mode == 2: @damp attributes operate full range -1..1, with -1.==low or high passes, negative values shelf attenuate, positive values shelf boost, 0.==bypass.
